title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani confronts her family for questioning her decision to sign the divorce papers. Anbu tries to persuade her to reconsider as he decides to return home, but she stands firm.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi treats Paraman after he suffers a bleeding wound. Later, Siddharth forces Kalamma to keep Paraman away from his alliance meeting with the minister's daughter.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: After promising Sudar to release Abinaya from the case, Vetri searches for evidence. Later, he finds a report in Sudar's bag revealing that Parvathy died after consuming poison.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Pechi feels touched by Mayandi's saree gift and shares her joy with Ilavarasi. Meanwhile, Poongodi reveals her revenge plan to disappear during the wedding event.

title: Sindhu Bairavi
description: Siva feels guilty for hurting Annapurani with his words. Bairavi challenges Arumugam's actions, while Essaki threatens Gayathri using a video.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
episodeTitle: Malar Takes a Risk with a Secret Visit
description: On Mathi's advice, Malar secretly visits her sick mother while Ragavan and Lakshmi are away. Tension rises as she rushes home, hoping to return before them.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: An intoxicated Kumar reveals to Sudar the reason he married her. Kathir grows anxious when Raji asks him to buy a pregnancy test kit.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila confronts Cheran over the unpaid work from his suggested client. Tension rises as Chozhan interferes and harshly criticises Cheran, leaving him and the entire family hurt.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Shruthi convinces Vijaya to hand over the money to the builder for Muthu and Meena's new room. Sinthamani urges Rekha to visit her sick father.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi joins a driving class to drive her gift car but feels uncomfortable with the trainer. Meanwhile, Sethupathi's lack of care and affection leaves Aishwarya distressed.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Arjun gets Madhu to revoke his termination, but tension escalates when he keeps her photo on his desk. Kasthuri seeks Karthik's help as her parents urgently ask her to come home.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: With Murugan's support, Indhira gains a reward at work and thanks him for his help. Later, she resumes her part-time work when her friends leave the hostel after their studies.
